rootCause.summary: Strict project-wide asset-pack discovery returned an error when any optional user/mod pack was invalid, causing editor and runtime catalog loaders to discard every valid built-in pack and fall back to the legacy pond-only stamp registry.

acceptance: The strict RuntimeAssetSession::discover path still fails for certification and smoke-test callers when any pack is invalid.
RuntimeAssetSession::discover_tolerant mounts all valid production packs and retains the complete discovery report.
StampRegistry::load_default uses tolerant discovery before legacy fallback.
The native editor Imports panel reports mounted packs, diagnostic failures, and stable source bindings.
The OGA LPC cliff ladder remains visible under Elevation & Cliffs even when a machine-local optional pack is invalid.
The game runtime keeps valid built-in packs mounted instead of dropping to legacy-only assets because of one optional-pack failure.
